description: For each date, tell whether it is a Japanese national holiday (with name and kind: 祝日 / 振替休日 / 国民の休日), a weekend, and a business day. Also returns today in Japan time. With country, the same for that country (holiday names, status, make-up workdays such as China's 调休).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. JP, US, CN, GB). Default JP.

include_government.description: Outside Japan: also treat days off only for government offices (e.g. Indonesia's cuti bersama, Canadian federal holidays) as days off.

region.description: Outside Japan: state/province code (ISO 3166-2 suffix, e.g. CA for California) to include regional holidays.

year_end_closed.description: Japan only: treat 12/29-1/3 as non-business days (common in Japanese companies).

name: check_dates
title: Check dates
